author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 21; ensure at least four current turns classified as billing_refund across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer bought a smartwatch that stopped charging after a week.

messages.content: Hi, my smartwatch arrived Tuesday and it was great for a few days.
Glad to hear it! How can I help you today?
Now it won't charge at all. The cable seems fine, I tested it on my phone.
I'm sorry about that. Have you tried cleaning the charging contacts on the back?

variants.text: Yes I did, still dead. I'd like a replacement sent out please.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Actually, you know what, forget it. I'll just deal with it.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: I cleaned them and it worked again! Thanks for the tip. By the way, do you sell screen protectors for this model?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer ordered a desk lamp but received a floor lamp instead.

messages.content: I ordered the Aurora desk lamp, order #48291.
Let me pull that up. What seems to be the issue?
The box says floor lamp on it. I opened it and it's definitely not what I ordered.
I apologize for the mix-up. Would you like a return label or a replacement?

variants.text: A replacement, but also can you check if the floor lamp I got is returnable for a refund?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Actually, I measured my desk and the floor lamp might work better. Keep it, no replacement needed.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Replacement please. And while you're at it, is the floor lamp compatible with smart plugs?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer's package shows delivered but they never received it.

messages.content: My order #7734 says delivered yesterday but I never got it.
Let me check the tracking. It shows delivered at 2:47 PM at your front door.
I was home all day, nobody rang the bell and nothing was left.
I understand your frustration. Let me open an investigation with the carrier.

variants.text: Thanks. Also, I want to speak to a real person about this, not a bot.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Actually, my neighbor just texted me — they have the package. Sorry for the trouble!
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Fine, investigate. But if it's truly lost, I expect a full refund, not a store credit.
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer asking about a coffee maker's water filter replacement.

messages.content: How often should I change the filter in the BrewMaster 3000?
The filter should be replaced every 60 brews or about every two months.
Okay, and where do I buy replacements? Do you stock them?
Yes, we carry the compatible filters. They're under 'accessories' on the product page.

variants.text: Perfect, I'll grab those. Oh, and thanks for the quick replies, you've been really helpful.
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Actually, I'm thinking of returning the whole machine. The brew temperature never gets hot enough for my taste.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Wait, I meant the charcoal filter in my water pitcher, not the coffee maker. Different thing entirely.
variants.label: __DEFER__

families.scenario: Customer's account was locked after too many login attempts.

messages.content: I can't log in, it says my account is locked.
I can help with that. This happens after several failed password attempts.
I think I typed my old password. Can you unlock it for me?
I've sent a verification code to your registered email. Please confirm it here.

variants.text: Got the code, it's 482913. Please unlock my account now.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Hmm, actually I don't need this account anymore. Can you delete it entirely?
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Before I do that — I placed an order yesterday, will unlocking affect its delivery?
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer received a damaged ceramic vase in shipment.

messages.content: My vase arrived shattered. Order #55120.
Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. Was the outer box damaged as well?
The box looked fine actually, but the vase is in pieces inside.
Understood. We can offer a replacement or a refund — which would you prefer?

variants.text: I'd like a refund please. I don't trust shipping ceramics again.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Refund, and also — is there a human I can file a complaint with about the packaging quality?
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Actually, my friend said she'd love the pieces for a mosaic project. No refund needed, thanks anyway!
variants.label: __DEFER__

families.scenario: Customer asking about shipping speed for a birthday gift.

messages.content: If I order the leather journal today, will it arrive by Friday?
With standard shipping it arrives in 3-5 business days. Express gets it there in 2.
Express it is then. My sister's birthday is Saturday.
Great choice. Express orders placed before 3 PM ship the same day.

variants.text: Perfect, I'll place the order now. Actually, do you gift wrap? That would save me a trip.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: On second thought, I'll just buy one at the mall tomorrow. Cancel my plan to order.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Wait, I already ordered this same journal last week for myself. Can I get a price adjustment on that one?
variants.label: billing_refund
